mapper.select: SELECT user_sub, first_name, last_name, phone_number, avatar_url, address, language_code FROM user_profiles WHERE user_sub = #{userSub} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profiles (user_sub, language_code, created_by) VALUES (#{userSub}, #{languageCode}, #{userSub}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE language_code = #{languageCode}, updated_by = #{userSub}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profiles SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, language_code = #{languageCode}, updated_by = #{userSub}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_sub = #{userSub} AND is_deleted = 0
